name: Adobe Express
makes: Multi-page social posts that work as carousels, among many other designs
apiNote: Express API through Firefly Services, by request; its MCP server serves developer docs, not designs
claimedFrom: search results; the Instagram post page lists no file formats and no carousel page exists
note: Good for teams already on Adobe; a carousel is a multi-page project, and Adobe has no dedicated carousel generator.

name: aiCarousels
makes: Carousels, image posts and short videos from an idea, a link, a PDF or a YouTube video
note: Takes many kinds of input and has ghostwriter voices; the free try is one carousel, and it posts only to LinkedIn.

name: Blotato
platforms: instagram; tiktok; linkedin; x; facebook; threads; pinterest
makes: Carousels, slideshows, infographics, quote cards and avatar videos
postsTo: x; linkedin; facebook; instagram; tiktok; youtube; threads; bluesky; pinterest
apiNote: Hosted MCP server, REST API and n8n and Make nodes, not in the trial
claimedFrom: search summaries of help.blotato.com template pages
note: One tool to make and post many formats to nine networks, with nodes for n8n and Make; the home page names no download formats.

name: BrandBird
makes: LinkedIn and Instagram carousels, plus other social graphics and app store screenshots
apiNote: API page and a JavaScript SDK linked from the footer
note: A design tool first that builds a carousel from a topic or a URL and can translate it; free exports carry a small watermark.

name: Canva
makes: Carousels as multi-page designs from templates, among almost any other design
exports: PNG; JPG; PDF; PPTX; GIF; MP4
apiNote: Connect REST API and a remote MCP server that create, edit, resize and export designs
claimedFrom: search results of canva.com template and feature pages, which blocked our reader; the API, MCP and export facts are from canva.dev
note: A very large template library and a full design editor, where you build each slide yourself; we could not confirm that its Content Planner posts carousels.

name: CarouselMaker.co
platforms: linkedin; instagram; tiktok; pinterest; facebook; x
makes: Carousels and infographics from a topic, in many languages
note: A simple topic-to-carousel maker with video and PowerPoint export; the home page names no image or PDF export and no posting.

name: Carousels Generator
makes: Carousels from a topic or a draft, edited in a chat
claimedFrom: Product Hunt listing (the site says it publishes and schedules but names no network)
note: You edit slides by chatting and can import a brand from a website or a PDF; its own page does not name the networks it posts to.

name: ChatSlide
makes: Presentations, with a social post mode that makes carousels as numbered images or one PDF
note: A presentation tool with a social post mode that uses stock images; you download the files and post them yourself.

name: CineRads
makes: TikTok slideshows built from a product web page
note: Fits online shops that want slideshows made from a product URL; the free start is three generations in total.

name: Contentdrips
makes: Carousels, quote cards, infographics and other social graphics
apiNote: REST API and MCP server; the pricing page lists them on the Pro plan
claimedFrom: a comparison article found in search; contentdrips.com does not name its export formats
note: Templates plus AI for carousels and graphics, with an API and MCP server for automation; the free plan is small.

name: ContentIn
makes: LinkedIn PDF carousels and static carousels, inside a LinkedIn writing and scheduling suite
apiNote: MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor on paid plans; a free agent tier only schedules and publishes
note: Fits LinkedIn creators who want carousels next to post writing and scheduling; the web app has a trial, not a free plan.

name: Decktopus
makes: AI presentations that can also be LinkedIn and Instagram carousels
apiNote: Remote MCP server for Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT; the plan is not stated
note: A presentation tool first, with carousels as one output; it does not post to social networks.

name: Faceless
makes: TikTok photo slideshows and Instagram carousels from your photos
note: The free browser maker puts your text on your photos with no sign-up and no AI; AI hooks and auto-posting are paid.

name: Gamma
makes: Presentations, documents and web pages, with a Social format for carousel cards
apiNote: REST API with keys on every plan, and a hosted MCP server
claimedFrom: search results of gamma.app guides, which blocked our reader; the API and MCP facts are from developers.gamma.app
note: Turns text or a document into designed cards; social carousels are one format of many, and you post them yourself.

name: Genviral
makes: TikTok and Instagram slideshows, plus UGC-style videos, ads and App Store screenshots
apiNote: REST API, CLI and a remote MCP server with 33 tools on every plan
note: Built for app marketers who want an AI agent to make and post slideshows; sign-up is free, but every plan is paid.

name: Ocoya
makes: Carousels designed in its studio and posted to Instagram or as LinkedIn PDF documents
postsTo: instagram; linkedin; facebook; x; pinterest; threads; tiktok; bluesky
apiNote: REST API with SDKs and an MCP server; the docs do not show carousel support
note: A scheduler with AI writing and a design studio that posts to many networks; it has a trial, not a free plan.

name: Piktochart
makes: AI carousels for Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn, plus infographics and presentations
claimedFrom: search results of piktochart.com carousel pages, which blocked our reader
note: An infographic tool that added AI carousel makers; it exports files for you to post yourself.

name: Pippit
makes: Photo slideshow videos and carousel templates, plus AI video and image tools
note: From the makers of CapCut; good for turning your photos into slideshow videos, but its slideshows are videos rather than photo posts.

name: PostEverywhere
platforms: instagram; tiktok; linkedin; facebook; threads; pinterest
makes: A scheduler with an AI studio for LinkedIn carousels and TikTok slideshows
postsTo: instagram; tiktok; linkedin; facebook; threads; pinterest
apiNote: API and hosted MCP server on every plan; the page does not say whether carousel making is exposed
note: A scheduler first that generates image carousels and slideshows from a prompt; it has a trial, not a free plan.

name: Postiv
makes: LinkedIn PDF carousels, inside a LinkedIn content and scheduling tool
note: Its free carousel maker needs no sign-up and exports a 1080x1350 PDF; the free maker does not post, so you upload the file yourself.

name: PostNitro
platforms: linkedin; instagram; tiktok; facebook; threads; pinterest; x
makes: Carousels, single-image posts and short animated posts on a brand kit
postsTo: linkedin; instagram; tiktok; threads; facebook; pinterest
apiNote: REST API, CLI and an MCP server with 40 tools, as an add-on or in higher plans
note: Makes carousels for seven networks and posts to six of them; scheduling and the API need a paid plan.

name: Predis.ai
makes: Carousels with slide text, caption and hashtags, plus ads, posts and videos
apiNote: REST API with a LinkedIn carousel endpoint, and an MCP server with a carousel preset that does not post
note: Fast prompt-to-carousel with scheduling, aimed at marketers and ads; it has a short trial, and its pages name no export formats.

name: ReelFarm
makes: TikTok slideshows and Instagram carousels, plus UGC-style videos
apiNote: REST API and an MCP server with 23 tools; the MCP docs say the MCP itself does not post
note: Fits marketers who copy proven TikTok slideshow formats and run accounts on autopilot; it finds images on the web instead of making them.

name: ReelMoney
makes: TikTok photo slideshows and short faceless videos, with scheduling
apiNote: MCP endpoint with a key: agents can make, schedule and read TikTok stats
note: Fits small businesses that want scheduled TikTok slideshows from ready image packs; Instagram is listed as coming soon.

name: SendShort
makes: TikTok photo slideshows from saved formats, posted on a schedule
apiNote: MCP and agent apps can list and schedule slideshows, not make new ones
note: Fits creators who want a repeatable TikTok photo series with a review step before posting; TikTok only.

name: Simplified
platforms: linkedin; instagram; tiktok; facebook; pinterest; x
makes: Editable AI carousels from a topic, inside a design, writing and scheduling suite
postsTo: linkedin; instagram; tiktok; facebook; pinterest; x
apiNote: REST API and a hosted MCP server; the MCP page does not mention carousels
claimedFrom: search results of simplified.com scheduler pages
note: An all-in-one suite for small teams that writes, designs and schedules; the free plan limits accounts and scheduled posts.

name: SlideFarm
makes: TikTok slideshows on your own images, in a phone app
note: Fits phone-first creators who bring their own images; the AI writes the text and it posts through TikTok, but it makes no images.

name: SlideReels
makes: TikTok and Instagram slideshows, plus UGC-style product videos
note: AI images and slides in one place with publishing to TikTok; the page offers the first slideshows free but does not describe a lasting free plan.

name: Slideshows.Studio
makes: Five-slide vertical slideshows with a hook, a caption and hashtags
note: Quick AI slides from a URL for people who post with another tool; it does not schedule or post.

name: SlideStorm
makes: TikTok slideshows with AI images and captions
apiNote: API guide linked from the site
note: Aimed at faceless accounts and app promoters, with many slideshows per prompt; the free plan covers the editor, and AI slides use credits.

name: Supergrow
makes: Branded LinkedIn carousels from a post, inside a LinkedIn writing and scheduling suite
apiNote: MCP server on Pro; API on Enterprise
note: Fits LinkedIn creators who want carousels bundled with a calendar and a queue; the full tool has a trial, and a separate free generator page exists.

name: Taplio
makes: LinkedIn PDF carousels and posts, with scheduling and analytics
apiNote: MCP server to search ideas and create or fetch drafts from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor
note: Fits LinkedIn-only creators who want carousels inside a full growth suite; it has a trial, not a free plan.

name: Typegrow
makes: LinkedIn carousels and posts, with scheduling
note: A LinkedIn-only tool that says it is free for now while a paid plan is in development; its pages name no export formats.

name: Venngage
makes: AI carousels and carousel templates, exported as images or a PDF
note: A simple topic-to-slides flow with a brand kit; it ends at the export and has no scheduler.

name: Viraloop
makes: Slideshows and about 20 other formats, such as UGC videos, memes and ads
apiNote: REST API, hosted MCP server, CLI and an agent skill on paid plans
note: Fits brands that want many formats made and posted from one profile built from their website; the free start is ten posts once.

name: Visme
makes: Instagram carousel posts from templates, plus presentations, documents and charts
exports: JPG; PNG; PDF; PPTX; GIF; MP4
note: Also makes charts, documents and presentations; carousels come from templates, and the free plan adds a watermark.

name: VistaCreate
makes: Instagram carousel templates and multi-page designs, scheduled as one carousel post
apiNote: API suite for the editor, templates and stock library, sold on request
claimedFrom: search results of support.create.vista.com help articles, which blocked our reader
note: A template editor with AI text and image tools and a scheduler for business accounts; carousels are built by hand from templates.

name: WaveGen
makes: LinkedIn PDF carousels, with a free maker that needs no sign-up
note: Built around LinkedIn PDF carousels with direct publishing; other platforms are named but described in less detail.

name: Wavegrain
platforms: tiktok; instagram; linkedin; facebook; threads; youtube
makes: TikTok slideshows and Instagram carousels from a topic, a website or a post you like
apiNote: Posting API under /api/v1 and a Carousel API in the docs, with access keys; an MCP server with 79 tools makes and schedules slideshows
note: Built for photo-led slideshows from your own photos or AI images, with approval before posting; it posts only to TikTok and YouTube.
